issue: Test / dummy records (ZZ IDs, clients like 'TEST CLIENT', 'Dummy Co')
Mixed date formats in submitted_date (5670 dd/mm/yyyy, 2884 'dd Mon yyyy')
impact: Naive parsing misreads or drops ~35% of dates
treatment: Parsed each format explicitly; slash dates are day-first (first part >12 in 3,400+ rows, second part never >12)

issue: Office names with inconsistent case / stray whitespace
impact: Splits one office into up to 5 labels

issue: Practice names with inconsistent case / stray whitespace
impact: Splits one practice into several labels
Without merging, one practice looks like it vanished and a new one appeared
treatment: Merged under 'Customer Strategy & Marketing' to keep 11 practices comparable

issue: Values keyed in USD thousands: every Tokyo proposal from 2026-04-01 (USD 30 - 4,226 vs median USD 249,400); no other office or period affected
impact: Understates Tokyo value ~1000x from Apr 2026 (likely a fiscal-year template change)
treatment: Multiplied by 1,000 by rule (office + date), cross-checked against an empty value band between USD 4,226 and 30,000; flagged in value_flag

issue: Extreme value outlier (USD 1.5B, ~6,027x median; 1000x keying error)
impact: Single row would be ~25% of total 2025 value

issue: proposal_id lost leading zeros in status_events (e.g. '10131' vs '0010131')
impact: A string join matches ~0% of events to proposals

issue: Status events with no matching clean proposal (test records)
Open proposals with no status change for >90 days (likely stale, never closed)
treatment: Kept as open; excluded from win rate and turnaround; flagged is_stale

issue: 30% of decided proposals skip 'Under Review' (Submitted straight to Won/Lost)
impact: Stage split only exists for reviewed proposals; skipping does not change win rate or speed
treatment: Stage chart uses reviewed proposals; total turnaround uses all; no-review median shown separately

issue: Right-censoring: recent proposals still open at extract (Jul-Oct 2026 cohorts)
impact: Recent cohorts only contain fast decisions, so turnaround looks better than it is
treatment: Turnaround trends use mature cohorts only (submitted on/before 2026-07-15, >=90 days before extract; slowest decision observed is 161 days)

issue: Missing submissions: zero proposals in Dubai 2026-08, Riyadh 2026-08 while the system kept logging status changes (105 events)
impact: Understates those offices' volume (Dubai Q3 looks -42%; India & ME looks flat)
treatment: Kept as received (cannot impute rows); growth also reported gap-adjusted, excluding that month in both years for those offices; confirm with the offices
